notes.title: Hyper Team Recon Is OUT NOW
notes.content:
HYPER TEAM RECON IS OUT NOW!
BOOM! BIG REVEAL!

ːshockedstar2022ːːshockedstar2022ː

Yes, it's here, it's finally here! As part of the Top Hat Studios Fall Showcase, the big news is that Hyper Team Recon is out, and you can play it RIGHT NOW!

What started as a small platformer passion project 5 or 6 years ago while I was at University has grown into something I'm incredibly proud to share with you all!



It's time to get out there and help those cute slime girls explore Earth!

ːshockedstar2022ːːshockedstar2022ː



Check out the full release trailer here! [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q3Et1VfjRyE"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Hyper Team Recon Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
HYPER TEAM RECON DEMO TIME!

Hyper Team Recon has a new demo, crash landing in your library right now as part of the Steam Next Fest!

In the demo, you'll be able to:


 Explore the Ayall space station in Chapter 1!
 Travel through the frozen ice caps in Chapter 2!
 Dress up the alien slime gang in the Scrapbook!
 Take on challenges with Herb, and more!


I'm SO EXCITED to share this slice of the game with you all, and I hope you all enjoy it!
